title: Boston Gas Company files for approval two (2) 365 Day Transportation Agreement with New Commonwealth Center Limited Partnership (Millennium Place) consisting of two projects identified as the South Tower and the North Tower.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the proposed Agreements. The Department finds that the pricing terms of each Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure, pursuant ot G.L. c. 25, § 5(d). Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC99-36)
